# MC-18: "Read from link": the web app reads one public Shopee product page and fills the fact sheet

- Source: `CEO-D-1313` (the CEO's own decision, 2026-10-27); local://research/ceo-decision-record.md#ceo-d-1313
- Issue type: Feature   Priority: Highest
- Labels: affiliate, shopee-video, pilot, operator-ux, web-app, fact-sheet, network-egress, vietnamese
- Routed as: /implement (implement-feature)
- Builds on: MC-17 (`src/MediaCompany.Pilot.Web`, run `run-022d0492a75a`, commit 3e220c0) on MC-16 (`src/MediaCompany.Pilot`).
  Neither is merged to `main`. Branch `claude/mc-18-shopee-read-link` is cut from `claude/mc-17-pilot-web-fffc59`.

## Description

### WHY

The CEO's words: "Tôi chấp nhận rủi ro và muốn tự động hoàn toàn." (I accept the risk and want it fully automatic.)
Today step 1 of the MC-17 web app asks the operator to type every fact of the fact sheet by hand from the product page,
and to save the three product images and the screenshot themselves. `CEO-D-1313` allows the tool to read the public
product page itself, one product per click, and to fill the fact sheet and save the images.

### WHAT THE OPERATOR DOES

1. At step 1, the operator pastes an affiliate link or a product link and presses one button.
2. The tool follows the link to the **public product page on shopee.vn**, reads that product's own name, price,
   classification, specifications, description and images, fills the fact sheet form and saves the images into the
   video's folder.
3. Every filled field is marked as read from the page. The operator reviews each fact, and the MC-16 fact-sheet check
   (banned terms, price spellings, use claims) runs exactly as for typed facts. Nothing is accepted without the
   operator's review.
4. If Shopee blocks the read, asks for sign-in, shows a CAPTCHA, or the page cannot be parsed, the tool stops and offers
   **paste mode**: the operator copies the page's text from their own browser and pastes it; the tool parses the paste
   and fills the same fields.

### WHAT THE COMPANY ALREADY HOLDS — REUSE IT

- MC-17's step 1 form, its live banned-term check, its image and screenshot steps, and its request guard.
- MC-16's fact sheet check, which stays the authority on what a fact sheet may hold.
- Installed on this machine: the .NET 10 SDK (`HttpClient`), and the headless browser the MC-17 tests already drive.

### HARD CONSTRAINTS (from `CEO-D-1313`, unchanged)

1. One product per operator click. No crawling of other pages, no category scan, no batch runs, no scheduled reads.
2. No sign-in, no cookies or session of the CEO, and affiliate.shopee.vn is never opened.
3. No CAPTCHA solving, no browser impersonation to evade anti-bot measures (no forged headers or signatures, no faked
   user agent), no IP rotation, no proxy. A block, a sign-in wall or a CAPTCHA means stop and offer paste mode.
4. Network egress only to shopee.vn hosts and only during the read step. The MC-16 toolchain stays at zero sockets and
   video composition stays fully offline. The web app keeps listening on 127.0.0.1 only.
5. Downloads are relaxed only for the product images of the product the operator supplied (`CEO-D-1303` relaxed per
   `CEO-D-1313` item 3).
6. Fetched facts pass the MC-16 fact-sheet check unchanged; the CEO reviews each fact and approves each video (`D-002`).
7. Stop condition (`CEO-D-1313` item 6): the read step can be switched off in one place, leaving paste mode working.
8. Download no package (no npm, NuGet or pip package, no CDN script) unless the CEO approves it by name. No generative
   model, no speech recognition, no metered service.
9. Agents never sign in, create accounts, contact sellers, buy or publish. Frozen MC-13 and MC-14 and the `mediacompany`
   database are not touched.
10. Tests run offline: product pages, blocked pages, sign-in walls and images are served by a code-generated local
    fixture server, never shopee.vn. No media file is added to the repository. Agents do not read shopee.vn during
    development unless the CEO allows it by name at the Scope Gate.

### OPEN FOR THE SCOPE GATE

- **Image hosts.** Shopee serves product images from hosts outside shopee.vn (for example `*.susercontent.com`). The
  decision names "máy chủ shopee.vn" only. The CEO decides whether the image CDN of the product is included.
- **Short links.** Affiliate links are commonly `s.shopee.vn/...` redirects; the read follows redirects only within the
  allowed hosts.
- **Live check.** Whether an agent may read one real public product page once, on the CEO's named link, to show the step
  working; otherwise the demo uses the local fixture and paste mode only.

### DONE MEANS

- MC-18 runs through every phase and gate of `implement-feature`; the CEO decides at the Scope and Design gates.
- The step is shown working in the Browser pane against the local fixture, including a block that falls back to paste
  mode.
- Committed and pushed on `claude/mc-18-shopee-read-link`; the CEO gets the compare link.

### FRAMEWORK DEFECTS TO BRIEF EVERY SUBAGENT ON

All in `research/framework-defects.md`. Every agent gets its own staging folder; a non-implementing role writes no
repository file; an agent claiming a finding covers "every" case lists the cases; a `failure-envelope.json` of class
`gate-approval-required` in a phase folder is stale once that phase's dispatch prompt exists (Finding 11).

## Acceptance criteria

_To be defined by the scope phase and approved at the Scope Gate._

# Business intent for MC-18 (the owner's request and decisions, verbatim)

## The CEO's request, 2026-10-27, in chat (relayed by the MC-16 session, confirmed directly in the MC-17 session)

"Tôi chấp nhận rủi ro và muốn tự động hoàn toàn. Hãy soạn quyết định CEO cho phép bot tự đọc trang sản phẩm qua link tiếp thị để tôi duyệt."
Approval of the draft: "chấp nhận nguyên văn". Confirmed in the MC-17 session: "Xác nhận, làm sau MC-17".

---

## The approved text, Vietnamese, as the CEO approved it

### CEO-D-1313 — Bot tự đọc trang sản phẩm Shopee để điền bảng thông tin

**Quyết định của CEO, 2026-10-27.** Lời CEO: "Tôi chấp nhận rủi ro và muốn tự động hoàn toàn."

1. **Được phép:** khi CEO đưa vào một link tiếp thị/link sản phẩm, công cụ mở **trang sản phẩm công khai trên
   shopee.vn** mà link đó trỏ tới, lấy tên, giá, phân loại, thông số, mô tả và ảnh của chính sản phẩm đó, rồi tự điền
   bảng thông tin và lưu ảnh vào thư mục video. Mỗi lần **một sản phẩm, do CEO bấm**; không tự dò trang khác, không
   quét danh mục, không chạy hàng loạt.
2. **Vẫn giữ:** không đăng nhập, không dùng cookie/phiên của CEO, không mở affiliate.shopee.vn (trang đó cần đăng
   nhập). Không vượt CAPTCHA, không giả trình duyệt để né chống bot, không đổi IP. Nếu Shopee chặn hoặc đòi đăng nhập
   → dừng và chuyển sang cách bán tự động (CEO dán nội dung trang vào, công cụ điền).
3. **Thay đổi:** quy định "không tải tài sản nào" (CEO-D-1303) được nới **riêng** cho ảnh sản phẩm CEO đưa vào; quy
   định chỉ kết nối nội bộ (CEO-D-1308) được nới **riêng** cho bước đọc trang tới máy chủ shopee.vn. Bước dựng video
   vẫn hoàn toàn ngoại tuyến.
4. **Kiểm tra giữ nguyên:** dữ liệu bot lấy vẫn qua phép kiểm tra bảng thông tin của MC-16 (từ cấm, cách viết giá,
   câu tự nhận đã dùng), CEO vẫn xem lại từng dữ kiện, và vẫn duyệt từng video trước khi đăng (D-002).
5. **Rủi ro CEO nhận (D-018):** điều khoản Shopee (E-105) cấm đối tác "thu thập bất kỳ thông tin nào trên Sàn TMĐT";
   bot đọc trang có thể bị coi là vi phạm → có thể bị khóa tài khoản affiliate và mất hoa hồng; E-107 phạt tới
   10 triệu đồng mỗi hành vi dùng nội dung không được phép.
6. **Điều kiện dừng:** Shopee trả lời Q-014 bất lợi hoặc gửi bất kỳ cảnh báo tài khoản nào → tắt bot ngay trong ngày,
   quay về cách bán tự động. Q-014 vẫn được gửi.

**Không đổi:** D-002, D-018; agent không tạo tài khoản, không liên hệ người bán, không mua, không đăng.

---

## CEO-D-1313 — The bot reads the public Shopee product page to fill the fact sheet

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-27.** The CEO's words: "Tôi chấp nhận rủi ro và muốn tự động hoàn toàn." (I accept
the risk and want it fully automatic.) The CEO approved the Vietnamese text verbatim ("chấp nhận nguyên văn") in the
MC-16 session and confirmed it directly in the MC-17 session, choosing to build it as a follow-up run after MC-17
closes. This entry is the English form.

1. **Allowed:** when the CEO supplies an affiliate link or product link, the tool opens the **public product page on
   shopee.vn** that the link points to. It takes that product's own name, price, classification, specifications,
   description and images, then fills the fact sheet and saves the images into the video folder. **One product at a
   time, on the CEO's click.** No crawling of other pages, no category scanning, no batch runs.
2. **Kept:** no sign-in, no use of the CEO's cookies or session, and affiliate.shopee.vn is not opened (it requires
   sign-in). No CAPTCHA solving, no browser impersonation to evade anti-bot measures, no IP rotation. If Shopee blocks
   the page or asks for sign-in, the tool stops and falls back to the semi-automatic mode: the CEO pastes the page
   content and the tool fills the sheet.
3. **Changed:** the "download no asset" rule (`CEO-D-1303`) is relaxed **only** for the product images of the product
   the CEO supplies. The local-connections-only rule (`CEO-D-1308`) is relaxed **only** for the page-reading step, to
   shopee.vn hosts. Video composition stays fully offline.
4. **Checks unchanged:** the data the bot takes still passes the MC-16 fact-sheet check (banned terms, price
   spellings, use claims). The CEO still reviews each fact, and still approves each video before it is published
   (`D-002`).
5. **Risk the CEO carries (`D-018`):** Shopee's terms (E-105) forbid partners from "collecting any information on the
   e-commerce platform". A bot reading pages may be judged a breach, which can mean the affiliate account is locked and
   commission is lost. E-107 sets a fine of up to 10 million dong for each unauthorised use of content.
6. **Stop condition:** if Shopee answers Q-014 unfavourably or sends any account warning, the bot is switched off the
   same day and the tool returns to the semi-automatic mode. Q-014 is still sent.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`. Agents create no account, contact no seller, buy nothing and publish nothing.

### 5.3 Selected Approach

- Selected: O-001 (where the read runs, D-001), the structural choice the other five families sit inside.
- Per-decision selections: D-002 O-006, D-003 O-009, D-004 O-012, D-005 O-015, D-006 O-018.
- Structural change: five new components inside the web app (M-001 to M-006), reached only through new guarded routes in M-007 and new step-1 page parts in M-008. A read click passes M-006 (switch on), M-001 (one link, allowed host), M-002 (one fresh HTTP stack, hop by hop, stop at the first signal), M-003 (structured data and visible text through the shared parser), M-004 (declared own images saved under generated names), then M-005 (fill record). Paste goes straight to M-003's shared parser and M-005, opening no connection. Saving facts keeps the MC-17 path and the unchanged check, adding one refusal for an unconfirmed filled field and placing picked read images. No toolchain file changes.
- Expected yield on real pages (answer to the planner's open question on yield; resting on A-002, unconfirmed until Q-006):
  - The read sends one honest request and calls no signed product endpoint, runs no page script, forges no header.
  - Most likely outcome: a script shell with no product data, or a verify or sign-in page; both end the read with "no readable product" or the matching stop, and paste mode is offered.
  - Best case: the server text carries a page title, description and image tag and a structured product block; the read then fills product name, page address and read date, shows price and description, and fetches the declared own images.
  - Classification and specification rows are rarely present in server text; they come from paste.
  - Paste mode is therefore expected to be the common path, and the read a best-effort shortcut; the page design leads with the link field and keeps the paste area one click away.
- Rationale: O-001 meets every hard constraint with the smallest impact surface, keeps every read behind the MC-17 guard and answer wrapper, and reuses the workspace, plain-name rule, waiting-folder pattern and live check. O-006 is honest and satisfies SC-22's "own value". O-009 needs no form-version change. O-012 is the only seam C-022 allows. O-015 matches CEO decision 1314 item 1. O-018 is the only rule that checks a hop before connecting.
- Highest-scoring rejected alternative and why it lost: O-005 ties O-001 on hard constraints and loses at impact surface (3 against 2), because the helper adds its own egress module and a link to the web app; it would also cost operability (a second executable to build, locate and digest-check at setup).
- Tradeoffs accepted:
  - Outbound HTTPS code runs inside the process that owns the loopback listener; the toolchain's guard is unaffected (F-022) and the listener is unchanged (M-010).
  - The honest user agent lets Shopee recognise and refuse the tool; a refusal is a stop, and paste mode follows (D-002).
  - Specification rows beyond three are offered as candidates, not saved, because the unchanged check allows 1 to 3 rows (A-009, D-013).
  - App-level and Browser-pane runs against the fixture use the test program's fixture host, not the shipped app (A-017).

## Operational Considerations

- Logging and observability updates: the read log (D-011, M-016) gives one line per outbound request; the MC-17 route log records the read, paste and confirm routes as for every route (F-004); SC-25 evidence pairs the read log with the address harness (A-015, M-018).
- Error handling strategy (S12):
  - Every stop is an expected outcome, not a fault: a Vietnamese reason, next step, code and paste offer, HTTP 200 to the page with ok false (D-010, C-007, C-028).
  - No retry anywhere, including after a timeout or a 5xx (C-007).
  - An image-phase stop keeps the filled facts and names the remaining images (D-010).
  - A file write fault takes the MC-17 file-error outcome (F-004).
  - A fill record that cannot be read is treated as absent for display and blocks nothing the MC-17 save would allow; a switch file that cannot be read means off (D-003).
- Security considerations (S09):
  - Egress only on a guarded click (C-023, M-009), only to hosts the rule admits before each connection (D-006), never to affiliate.shopee.vn (C-011), with a connect-time refusal of non-public addresses so a Shopee name resolving to this computer or the local network is a stop (R-006).
  - No cookie store, no Authorization, no proxy, no automatic redirect; an honest fixed header list (D-002, C-010, C-012, C-013).
  - Fetched content is untrusted: page text is shown in the page as text, never as markup (R-011); images are named by the app, kept only with a PNG or JPEG signature, bounded in size and count (C-024, D-014).
  - The content policy is unchanged: the page never contacts Shopee; read images are served from the app's origin (M-009).
  - The test seam is internal and never set by the shipped entry point (C-022, D-004).
  - Compliance: the CEO carries the terms risk (S-019); the switch is the stop condition (S-020); the single live read is the orchestrator's (C-018).
- Performance considerations (S08): bounded by C-026 through D-014; the live check over filled values is bounded by C-025 (A-011); one read at a time app-wide.
- Deployment or operability impact: the same single web executable and setup; the switch starts off until the operator turns it on in the settings view (D-003, A-010); no database, container or service (D-012). The S06 database area changes nothing.

Its write scope cannot be enumerated per agent, because the files a change touches are named by the accepted design rather than by the manifest. The scope is therefore the repository, minus the evidence classes below, and every file actually written is declared in the change set and in the result envelope, where the runtime compares them.
repositoryWrites.exclusionRationale: Committed run evidence and governance records are immutable to the agents whose work they record. A run artifact this agent could edit would let a change rewrite the evidence assessed against it.

determinism.contract: Identical approved inputs and an identical context snapshot must produce the same change-set entry set, the same test-evidence set, the same deviation set, and the same declared verification status.
determinism.orderingRule: Change-set entries are ordered by the sequence in which the accepted design requires them; ties break toward the lower path in lexical order. Test-evidence entries follow the change-set entries they cover.
determinism.modelIndependence: No module may reference a specific model, vendor, or agent runtime. Technology names are permitted only when they trace to the supplied design, standards, or repository context.
